name: TrustDemoIND03
title: TD.IND.03 CHW referrals for verification completed at the clinic
description: Of the referrals community health workers make for a child's foreign cards to be verified, the proportion completed at the clinic.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J2B.DE02 Referred by; TD.J2B.DE03 Referred to; TD.J2B.DE04 Referred at; TD.J2B.DE06 Doses to verify; TD.J2B.DE07 Referral status. Decision tables: TD.DT.01. Requirements: STT-VER-011. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Referrals for verification made by community health workers in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of referrals (TD.J2B) WHERE "Referred at" is in the reporting period

population.description: Referrals made in the reporting period for which the clinic has recorded an outcome for every dose the referral lists.

criteria.expression: COUNT of referrals (TD.J2B) WHERE "Referred at" is in the reporting period AND "Referral status" = completed
